title: 第13章 抓住脚腕直接摔在了地上第14章 一打六都打赢了简直是怪物
slug: 聚灵飞升第1126章暗流之下
content_zh:
酒楼内，金满堂安排云昊入座。
云昊看着大堂墙上挂着的木牌子，上面写满了各种菜肴的名字以及下面的价格。
心里暗暗咋舌，不愧是镇上最大的酒楼。
除了装修豪华之外，每一样菜肴的价格也是很吓人。
哪怕就是一碗普通的杂粮面，外面小摊上只需要几文钱，但这里最低的都是十五文起步。
金满堂看着云昊眼底的惊讶，很满意，任何人第一次来他们品味酒楼都很有冲击感。
星河镇地处边陲，但却是战略重镇，因为前来的客人不乏高端客户，菜肴的价格消费的起。
云昊一个山村少年，很明显是第一次来高端酒楼。
笑呵呵说道：“云兄弟想吃什么尽管点，我请你。”
金满堂又强调了一句，在外面都说了请云昊，就不会食言，一顿饭而已对他这个掌柜来说小问题。
也补充道：“外面那些人，你放心，给他们胆子，也不敢进来闹事，你只管安心吃饭。”
“多谢金掌柜解围。”
云昊倒不是害怕，才跟着金满堂进酒楼躲避。
只是金满堂邀请，二来也是圆个梦，来品味酒楼吃一顿饭，这才进酒楼。
这一点，在云河等人眼中就是云昊害怕躲进了酒楼。
金掌柜嘱咐小二招呼云昊后，就去了楼上。
云昊随后点了两碗面，一盘菜，一份烤鸡。
烤鸡交代小二要包起来，他自然是带回去给姐姐吃。
面是杂粮阳春面，葱花和花椒油很足，份量也大。
云昊很满意，大口吃了起来。

两大碗吃下去感觉小饱都不到。
索性让小二再上三大碗。
一口气吃了五大碗面加一盘菜，喝了一碗面汤，才感觉舒坦了，饱是饱了，但不是很饱。
喊来小二结账。
尽管金掌柜说了请客，但他不想占这个便宜。
五大碗面七十五文，一盘菜二十文，一只烧鸡八十文，总共加起来，一百七十五文。
有点肉疼，但也掏了。
拿上烧鸡准备离开，这时候金掌柜正好下楼来，看着云昊付钱要走，却是走了下来，笑呵呵道：“云兄弟你也太客气了啊！
都说了这顿饭我请你吃。”
“多谢金掌柜好意，你们开门做生意，我吃饭掏钱理所应当，时间不早了，我先告辞。”
云昊道。
金满堂走过来看了一眼门外道：“你现在出去，可能会吃亏，流云武馆那些武夫还守在外面，你不出去，他们不敢进来造次。”
“多谢金掌柜好意，我不能一直躲着不出去，我不怕他们。”
云昊少年气性上来，目光坚定无比。
金满堂听云昊这么说，倒也不强求什么，他今天帮云昊，也只是出于云昊在他酒楼门口和他做生意，真要是被流云武馆的人打了云昊，他金满堂没面子。
但并不认为，云昊能在外面那些流云武馆的武夫手下占到便宜。
云昊向外走去，到门口的时候，想起来宝瓶空间还有剩下的三头野猪，便问金满堂道：“金掌柜以后我猎到野猪还能送来你们酒楼吗？”
金满堂笑道：“当然可以，越多越好，保证给你最高的价格。”
“那就多谢金掌柜了，对了，你们酒楼需要大米吗？”
云昊想着自己有宝瓶在手，按照三天成熟一次的时间，以后大米会越来越多，吃是吃不完的，能卖掉一些也是好的，故此一问。

金满堂当即说道：“今年大旱，粮食价格高涨，我们对粮食的需求很大，多数都还是从外地调拨，云兄弟要是有粮食，有多少我收多少。”
云昊心里有底了，准备回头陆续将手头粮食出售。
看着云昊离开的背影，金满堂暗道了一声可惜，他对云昊的感观还不错，但更清楚在星河镇这样的小地方，武夫就是天，云昊被打死的可能性很大。
小二凑上来问道：“掌柜的你为什么要帮那小子？”
content_en:
In the restaurant, Jin Mantang arranged for Yunhao to take a seat.
Yunhao looked at the wooden sign hanging on the wall in the lobby, which was filled with the names of various dishes and the prices below.
I was secretly stunned. It was indeed the largest restaurant in town.
In addition to the luxurious decoration, the price of each dish is also very scary.
Even an ordinary bowl of multi-grain noodles only costs a few pennies at the stalls outside, but the lowest price here starts at fifteen cents.
Jin Mantang looked at the surprise in Yun Hao's eyes and was very satisfied. Anyone who came to their Taste Restaurant for the first time would be shocked.
Xinghe Town is located on the border, but it is a strategic town because there are many high-end customers who come here, and the prices of the dishes are affordable.
Yunhao, a boy from a mountain village, was obviously visiting a high-end restaurant for the first time.
He said with a smile: "Brother Yun, just order whatever you want to eat. I'll treat you."
Jin Mantang emphasized again that he would not break his promise if he invited Yun Hao outside. Just one meal was a small problem for him as the shopkeeper.
He also added: "Don't worry about those people outside. Give them the courage and don't dare to come in and make trouble. You just have to eat in peace."
"Thank you, Shopkeeper Jin, for the rescue."
Yun Hao was not afraid, so he followed Jin Mantang into the restaurant to escape.
It was just Jin Mantang's invitation, and secondly it was to fulfill a dream of coming to Taste Restaurant for a meal, so he entered the restaurant.
In the eyes of Yun He and others, Yun Hao was afraid and hid in the restaurant.
Shopkeeper Jin asked the waiter to greet Yun Hao and then went upstairs.
Yunhao then ordered two bowls of noodles, a plate of vegetables, and a piece of roast chicken.
The waiter told the waiter to wrap the roasted chicken, so he naturally took it back to his sister to eat.
The noodles are multi-grain Yangchun noodles with plenty of green onion and peppercorn oil, and the portion is large.
Yunhao was very satisfied and started eating.
After eating two large bowls, I didn't even feel full.
Simply let the waiter serve three more bowls.
I ate five large bowls of noodles and a plate of vegetables in one go, and drank a bowl of noodle soup before I felt comfortable. I was full, but not very full.
Call the waiter to pay.
Although shopkeeper Jin said he would treat him, he didn't want to take advantage of it.
Five large bowls of noodles cost seventy-five cents, a plate of vegetables costs twenty cents, and a roast chicken costs eighty cents. The total adds up to one hundred and seventy-five cents.
It hurt a little, but I took it out.
After taking the roast chicken and preparing to leave, shopkeeper Jin happened to come downstairs. Seeing Yun Hao pay and leave, he walked down and said with a smile: "Brother Yun, you are too polite!
I told you I would treat you to this meal. "
"Thank you so much for your kindness, Shopkeeper Jin. You are open for business. It's natural for me to pay for my meals. It's getting late, so I'll take my leave first."
Yun Hao said.
Jin Mantang walked over and looked outside the door and said, "If you go out now, you may suffer a loss. The martial artists from Liuyun Martial Arts School are still guarding outside. If you don't go out, they won't dare to come in and cause trouble."
"Thank you, Shopkeeper Jin, for your kindness. I can't hide away all the time. I'm not afraid of them."
Yun Hao's youth became angry and his eyes were firm.
When Jin Mantang heard what Yun Hao said, he didn't force anything. He helped Yun Hao today just because Yun Hao was doing business with him at the door of his restaurant. If Yun Hao was really beaten by someone from Liuyun Martial Arts Hall, Jin Mantang would lose face.
But he didn't think that Yun Hao could take advantage of the martial artists from the Liuyun Martial Arts School outside.
Yun Hao walked out. When he reached the door, he remembered that there were three wild boars left in the Aquarius Space, so he asked Jin Mantang: "Shopkeeper Jin, can I still bring wild boars to your restaurant if I hunt them?"
Jin Mantang smiled and said: "Of course, the more, the better. I promise to give you the highest price."
"Thank you so much, Shopkeeper Jin. By the way, does your restaurant need rice?"
Yun Hao thought that he had a treasure vase in his hand. According to the time of ripening once every three days, there would be more and more rice in the future. It would be endless to eat, so it would be good to sell some, so he asked.
Jin Mantang immediately said: "There is a severe drought this year and food prices are soaring. We have a huge demand for food. Most of them are stillAllocate food from other places. If Brother Yun has food, I will collect as much as he can. "
Yunhao felt confident and prepared to go back and sell the grains on hand one after another.
Looking at Yun Hao's leaving figure, Jin Mantang secretly said it was a pity. He had a good impression of Yun Hao, but he knew more clearly that in a small place like Xinghe Town, martial arts were king, and there was a high possibility that Yun Hao would be beaten to death.
The waiter came up and asked: "Shopkeeper, why do you want to help that kid? "
